categories.main_business_segments: EPAM Systems operates through three main geographic segments: North America, Europe, and Russia. The company organizes its business primarily by managerial responsibility for client relationships, which generally aligns with customer geography. Its core service offerings span software engineering, digital platform development, consulting, design, and managed services, delivered across five primary industry verticals: Financial Services, Travel & Consumer, Business Information & Media, Software & Hi-Tech, and Life Sciences & Healthcare, as well as a group of Emerging Verticals.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: EPAM leverages advanced software engineering, agile delivery, proprietary project management tools, and a global delivery model. The company integrates custom software development, platform engineering, cloud, AI, robotics, process automation, and digital experience design. Its production methods emphasize end-to-end lifecycle services, including requirements analysis, platform integration, testing, maintenance, and managed services, supported by distributed teams and specialized knowledge.
categories.primary_customers_markets: EPAM serves a geographically diverse client base across multiple industries, focusing on large enterprises and leading organizations. Its primary markets include financial institutions, travel and hospitality companies, retailers, software and technology firms, media and information providers, life sciences, healthcare, and a range of emerging sectors such as energy, telecom, automotive, and manufacturing. The company maintains long-term relationships, with over half of revenue from customers of at least five years.
categories.geographic_coverage: EPAM operates globally, with major delivery centers in Ukraine, Belarus, Russia, India, Poland, the United States, Hungary, and Mexico. Its customers are primarily located in the Americas (notably the United States), EMEA (including the UK, Switzerland, Netherlands, Germany), CEE (Russia, Belarus, Ukraine), and APAC regions. The company’s delivery model supports on-site, off-site, and offshore engagements worldwide.
categories.supply_chain_position: EPAM operates as a downstream provider in the IT services and digital transformation supply chain, delivering end-to-end solutions directly to enterprise clients. It acts as a strategic partner, integrating technology, consulting, and design services to address clients’ business challenges and digital needs.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: EPAM’s strategic priorities include expanding its service capabilities beyond traditional software engineering into business consulting, experience design, and emerging technologies such as AI, robotics, and virtual reality. The company invests heavily in R&D, innovation labs, and employee training, and pursues strategic acquisitions to enhance domain expertise, geographic reach, and service offerings. Continuous improvement in process methodologies and information security is also a focus.
categories.revenue_model: EPAM generates the majority of its revenue from professional services delivered under time-and-materials and fixed-price contracts, with a small portion from licensing and other sources. Revenue is recognized as services are performed or upon delivery of solutions, with most contracts billed based on hours worked or project milestones.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: EPAM competes with global technology and consulting firms such as Accenture, Capgemini, Cognizant, Deloitte Digital, Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro, and others, as well as regional and niche providers. The company differentiates itself through deep technical expertise, complex software product development, and a reputation for high-quality, on-time delivery, positioning itself as a leader in digital platform engineering and transformation services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2021, EPAM reported revenues of $3.76 billion, a 41.3% increase over the prior year, with net income of $482 million and an effective tax rate of 9.7%. The company has demonstrated rapid organic and acquisitive growth, expanding both its client base and service capabilities, and is a member of the S&P 500 and Forbes Global 2000. Cash flow from operations was $572 million, and the company maintains a strong balance sheet with significant liquidity.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: EPAM’s value proposition centers on delivering end-to-end digital transformation through a unique combination of advanced software engineering, business consulting, and experience design. The company emphasizes its ability to solve complex technical challenges, provide tailored solutions, and drive innovation for clients. Its global delivery model, highly skilled workforce, and focus on quality, security, and customer experience distinguish EPAM in a competitive market.
